title: Interior Finishes

stage.name: Finishing touches
stage.description: Floors, cabinets, paint and light: rooms that feel like home.

questions.prompt: Why is painting usually done before the final flooring goes in?
options: So drips and spills don't damage the new floors
questions.why: Finishes go in an order that protects the work already done.

questions.prompt: Match each finish to what it is.
pairs: Edges around doors, windows and floors
questions.why: Small details, done well, make a room feel finished.

questions.prompt: Finish work happens after the walls are closed.
questions.why: Paint, trim and cabinets need finished walls to go on.

questions.prompt: What turns a house into a home for a couple?
options: Rituals and traditions that are yours
Living separate lives in the same house
questions.why: Shared rituals, big or small, give a home its feeling.

talk: What's a small ritual you'd love to share, like Sunday breakfast or an evening walk?
